tests.reason: the platform part of VTID-04915 is a database migration (host entry on create, edits move every live entry, delete cancels them) with no gateway code. Its behaviour is proven on a throwaway Postgres next to the VTID-04321 attendee trigger (CI SQL-COMMUNITY-EVENT-CALENDAR, two mutation checks); this suite pins the safety properties. Staging shares the production Supabase project, so verification never creates, edits or deletes an event.
